events.title: IMAN Demo is Now Available!

events.title: (ENDED) Limited-Time Public Playtest
events.summary: ENDED: Playtest has concluded. Thank you so much for all of the players who participated and gave feedback!IMAN is a 2D pixel adventure-horror bullet-hell rooted in Indonesian folklore. This playtest gives you a hands-on look at the world of Rudi, the possessed, and the praying mechanics that stand between the living and the damned.What to expect:A hands-on slice of IMAN's adventure-horror gameplayA first look at our rotoscoped animation and pixel-horror art directionEncounters drawn from Indone

events.title: Introducing Our First Horror Game: 'IMAN'
events.summary: About 'IMAN'IMAN is a 2D horror-adventure game. Step into the shoes of Rudi, a devout young man, in a chilling experience heavily inspired by the widely beloved "FAITH: The Unholy Trinity". Unravel dark mysteries, save the possessed, and rely on your faith to survive the deceit of cursed demons.Developed by PondakoPondako is an indie development team based in South Tangerang, Indonesia.
